reviewPrompts.title: Iron handling is the main follow-up thread
reviewPrompts.detail: January showed low ferritin/iron saturation; April shows ferritin normalised with high transferrin saturation. Keep this tied to clinician review rather than simple self-optimisation.

reviewPrompts.title: Wearables show low resting pulse
reviewPrompts.detail: WHOOP resting HR and Randox pulse both sit low. Treat as a tracking item unless symptoms change the context.

reviewPrompts.title: Sleep consistency is visible enough to manage
reviewPrompts.detail: WHOOP has current recovery, sleep performance, HRV, RHR, and respiratory-rate coverage. Freshness matters because the latest curated WHOOP date is visible in the source panel.

reviewPrompts.title: Nutrition data is useful but older
reviewPrompts.detail: Cronometer rolling summaries are rich, but the latest logged nutrition window is earlier than the current WHOOP and bloodwork windows.
